children: LEBANON, Tenn., Sept. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cracker Barrel Old Country Store, Inc. ("Cracker Barrel" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: CBRL) plans to release its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter financial results before the market opens on Wednesday, September 23, 2026 with a conference call to follow at 8:15 a.m. Eastern Time. Company management will discuss financial results for the fiscal fourth quarter ended July 31, 2026.
The live broadcast of Cracker Barrel's quarterly conference call will be available to the public online in the Events and Presentations section on the Company's website at
.  An online replay will also be available.
Cracker Barrel Old Country Store, Inc. (Nasdaq: CBRL) was established in 1969 in Lebanon, Tenn. and operates over 650 Cracker Barrel locations.
SOURCE Cracker Barrel Old Country Store, Inc.
